blockers.description: The rolling site is not an exact rendering of the reviewed 2.21.0 tree.
Notebook and serialized/binary assets remain external and are not interpreted.
The exact documentation and source bodies are not bundled.

fairchem-v2-binary-doc-assets.rationale: Non-text assets are retained in tree inventory only and never executed, opened, or deserialized.
fairchem-v2-binary-doc-assets.title: FairChem v2 notebooks and binary documentation assets

fairchem-v2-rolling-main.rationale: The rolling site differs from the exact 2.21.0 source and is not an exact-version replacement.
fairchem-v2-rolling-main.title: FairChem rolling main documentation

limitations: The rolling rendered site differs from exact release 2.21.0.
Non-text assets remain external and uninterpreted.
The inventory identity binds the exact pre-migration catalog bytes as migration metadata; it does not identify any upstream document body.

fairchem-v2-bodies-external.description: Exact v2 docs, source, and repository metadata bodies remain external.

fairchem-v2-nontext-assets-excluded.description: Non-text assets are inventoried but not interpreted, executed, or deserialized.

fairchem.v2.docs.binary.assets.statement: Notebook, trajectory, pickle, CIF, XYZ and image assets are recorded only at tree-inventory level and are never executed, deserialized, or treated as documentation text.
fairchem.v2.docs.binary.assets.title: FairChem v2 binary documentation assets

fairchem.v2.docs.inventory.statement: The exact docs tree contains 95 paths and 66 Markdown source pages; the MyST table of contents selects 64 pages.
fairchem.v2.docs.inventory.title: FairChem v2 docs inventory

fairchem.v2.docs.orphans.statement: oc20_slabs.md and benchmark.md are source pages outside the 64-page MyST table of contents and must not disappear from source-tree coverage.
fairchem.v2.docs.orphans.title: FairChem v2 orphan-page coverage

fairchem.v2.framework.identity.statement: The reviewed repository source, UMA model repository, pretrained weights, datasets, and reference-DFT artifacts require separate identity and provenance records.
fairchem.v2.framework.identity.title: FairChem v2 framework source identity

fairchem.v2.release.identity.statement: FairChem v2 is pinned to tag fairchem_core-2.21.0, commit f47a0a6f0f594ea051b70091304864242df933e1.
fairchem.v2.release.identity.title: FairChem v2 exact release identity

fairchem.v2.rolling.drift.statement: The rolling main documentation differs from exact tag 2.21.0 and cannot substitute without an explicit drift review.
fairchem.v2.rolling.drift.title: FairChem v2 rolling-site drift

fairchem.v2.source.api.closure.statement: The exact source-tree identity is retained for API-reference closure, but source bodies and embedded tensor assets remain external.
fairchem.v2.source.api.closure.title: FairChem v2 source/API closure

fairchem.v2.v1.incompatibility.statement: FairChem v2 is a breaking rewrite and does not accept v1 APIs or pretrained artifacts as interchangeable evidence.
fairchem.v2.v1.incompatibility.title: FairChem v2/v1 hard boundary
